1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Echo of Vengeance and Echo of Righteousness would not trigger from all abilities.

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] Fixed an issue where TBC PvP Set piece gloves and legs did not all have their intended gem slots. All Arena gear and the Blue pvp gear (High Warlord's/Grand Marshal's) should have one gem slot for hands and two gem slots for legs.

0.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Pit Lord Vilemus was not spawning more than 1 Orb per fight.
[Elune] [Area-52]Further improved Dynamic Respawning for the callboard quest area zones. The spawn time of monsters will be reduced when there are many players in the area.
[Elune] Reduced the damage dealt by the triggered spells from the Dungeon set bonuses by 30% in PvP combat.
[Elune] [Area-52] Fixed a bug causing Protean Spawn to deal far to much damage in the Manastorm.
Fixed an issue where Tier 1 Blacksmithing Weapons and the first pair of Engineering Goggles were not able to be trained.
[Pending Restart] Killing Clepto the Cardnapper will now give every party member the loot right away. You no longer have to click the spawned cards to get loot.

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] Fixed an issue causing the Resilience on many items not to display correctly. This seems to primarily have affected Bloodforged items.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Corruption spells that are applied via other spells, for example from Shadowburn with Corrupting Shadows, now deals 20% reduced damage in PvP combat.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Echo of Vengeance from Twist of Faith would not trigger for Horde players.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Champion's Spear now deals increased damage. 200% weapon damage on hit and 50% weapon damage every second. The cooldown is now 1 minute, changed from 2 min.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Ravager now deals 100% weapon damage every second, changed from 50%.
